target: मेरे भाई की पत्नी टीचर हैं।
english: My brother's wife is a teacher.
reason: Original was a textbook kinship definition ('my brother's wife is called our bhabhi') – nobody says this out loud; it teaches a glossary entry, not speech. Replacement keeps the same possessive + हैं pattern with an ordinary statement.

target: कमला ने रसोई में नई सब्ज़ी बनाई।
english: Kamala made a new vegetable dish in the kitchen.
reason: व्यंजन is written/menu register; in spoken Hindi people say सब्ज़ी / खाना / डिश. Same ने + perfective structure, everyday wording.

target: निखिल ने कल नई साइकिल ख़रीदी।
english: Nikhil bought a new bicycle yesterday.
reason: Word-for-word duplicate of hi-0770 (same sentence, only the name changed) – zero new value in the same node. Replacement keeps ने + perfective with fresh common vocabulary.

target: मैंने टिकट खिड़की पर आधा घंटा इंतज़ार किया।
english: I waited half an hour at the ticket window.
reason: 'यात्रियों ने ... लंबी क़तार लगाई' is newspaper register; spoken Hindi uses लाइन, not क़तार, and doesn't narrate 'travellers' this way. Replacement is the same ने + perfective in natural speech.

target: पापा बाहर गाड़ी धो रहे हैं।
english: Dad is washing the car outside.
reason: Near-duplicate of hi-0862 (same 'रसोई में ... बना रही है' frame in the same node), and माँ normally takes the honorific plural (बना रही हैं). Replacement keeps present continuous with distinct, natural content.

target: नेहा बिना पूछे अंदर नहीं जा सकती।
english: Neha can't go inside without asking.
reason: 'बिना अनुमति के' is bureaucratic/notice-board register and the fronted phrase is stiff; everyday speech is बिना पूछे / बिना इजाज़त. Same सकना negation pattern.

target: ऑनलाइन पेमेंट कैश से ज़्यादा आसान होता है।
english: Online payment is easier than cash.
reason: Original had wrong gender agreement (पेमेंट is masculine, so हो जाती है is off) and 'payment happens faster' is awkward phrasing. Replacement is a clean X से ज़्यादा Y comparative.
'जून बहुत गरम है' is translationese – Hindi says गर्मी है (heat), and a month isn't described as गरम. Same simple है predicate, same month vocabulary.
